row: We are one of Orange County's oldest Animal Hospitals serving the pet health care needs of the Costa Mesa, Newport Beach, Irvine and surrounding cities since 1947. Our pet health services include a full range of medical services for canine and feline health. We are proud to have a Board Certified Theriogenologist on staff for all reproduction needs and education, as well as a Certified Veterinary Acupuncturist. With eight highly skilled veterinarians, and our dedicated staff members, your pets are as important to us as they are to you! Our high tech facilities offer the latest array of equipment to serve your pet's medical needs for effective and efficient treatment.
